text:
Evidence supports a diagnostic panel, but does not establish its probes as universal predictors of ranking quality. [Guo et al., ICML 2024](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v235/guo24e.html) identify low-dimensional embedding collapse as a scalability bottleneck. This motivates spectral effective rank alongside mean cosine; neither alone proves retrieval failure. Proposed implementation: report singular-value entropy rank with explicit normalization, embedding norms, and fixed-temperature score entropy/top-score gaps. Calibrate their relationship to HR@10 through controlled changes within each category; score concentration also reflects logit scale.

Candidate sampling can change model ordering. [Hidasi and Czapp, RecSys 2023](https://hidasi.eu/assets/pdf/eval_flaws_recsys23.pdf) demonstrate reversals between full-catalog and sampled evaluation; [Subbiah et al., 2024](https://research.google/pubs/improved-estimation-of-ranks-for-learning-item-recommenders-with-negative-sampling/) study correcting sampled-rank bias. Therefore, compare fixed uniform, popularity-weighted, and harder candidate sets as auxiliary sensitivity probes. Keep the pinned 99-negative macro validation HR@10 as the selection objective; auxiliary full-catalog retrieval measures a different task.

[Time to Split, 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.16289) shows that temporal splitting affects model rankings and that per-user leave-one-out can violate the global timeline. Training-prefix retrieval is consequently an auxiliary consistency check, not independent generalization evidence when the model already trained on its targets. For comparisons, retain per-user outcomes and bootstrap paired model differences within categories before macro-averaging. These intervals describe user-sampling uncertainty, not training-seed variability or adaptive-selection bias. [NeurIPS 2024 research](https://mcml.ai/publications/nsb%2B24/) documents validation overfitting during hyperparameter optimization. Practical implication: predeclare comparisons, log every attempted trial and GPU cost, and treat winner-only intervals cautiously under the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget.
